t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Early in the game, you can just select random gnomes to see which colours give the higher amount of mushrooms, and then once you establish a pattern, you can begin to purposefully choose the higher-mushroom-giving gnomes. It might change throughout the game, in which case you just do the technique again.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will always be shown to you in the same colour pairs, so once you begin each new round, try each colour in the pair to see which gnome gives you more mushrooms, and then make a mental note of the four colours that give you the highest amount of mushrooms per round. Sometimes it might change, so if your colour choice starts to give you less mushrooms for 2-3 choices in a row, then switch to the other gnome.
